title: emit_campaign_content input, A/B (strict variant sent to the model when the marketer asked for an A/B test)
description: Strict-compatible variant of ../content.schema.json with the `b` block and `angles` required (P9, D64). Same structure as content.tool.json plus `b` (variant B) and `angles`; no minLength/maxLength. Length limits (after personalization), the 60-character angle limit, the identical-variants rule and template-variable rules are enforced only by the backend validator.

body.description: Variant A. Plain-text SMS template. At most 160 Unicode characters after personalization. Allowed variables: {{first_name}}, {{last_name}}, {{city}}.

subject.description: Variant A. Plain-text email subject template. At most 80 Unicode characters after personalization.

body.description: Variant A. Plain-text email body template (no HTML; blank line = new paragraph). The backend renders it to escaped HTML. At most 5000 Unicode characters.

b.description: Variant B: the same offer, audience and tone as variant A, told from a deliberately different angle. Same limits and variables. Must not repeat variant A's texts.

body.description: Variant B. Plain-text SMS template. At most 160 Unicode characters after personalization. Allowed variables: {{first_name}}, {{last_name}}, {{city}}.

subject.description: Variant B. Plain-text email subject template. At most 80 Unicode characters after personalization.

body.description: Variant B. Plain-text email body template (no HTML; blank line = new paragraph). The backend renders it to escaped HTML. At most 5000 Unicode characters.

angles.description: One short Turkish label per variant naming the angle it tries (at most 60 characters each, plain text, no variables), e.g. "İndirim oranı öne çıkar" / "Aciliyet: indirim bugün bitiyor".

a.description: Angle of variant A. At most 60 characters.

b.description: Angle of variant B. At most 60 characters.
